title: Sequoia Burl
body: Burls are a sub-resource of trees. Sequoia Burls rarely spawn on Sequoia Trees. Due to Sequoia Trees being roughly the same width all along the tree, and taller than all other trees, burls spawn along the entire length of the tree rather than just the base, making them easier to find through looking at the entire tree from a distance and searching for bumps, than looking at the base of trees individually like most others.
